title: Capuchin monkey fairness experiment
summary: A one-minute clip from Frans de Waal's TED talk showing two capuchin monkeys given unequal rewards (cucumber versus grape) for the same task. The monkey receiving the lesser reward reacts with protest.
why: HN uses it as shorthand for the innate human and primate sense of fairness in threads on pay, wealth and inequality.

quote.text: Certainly getting a cucumber is infinitely better than not having a cucumber, and yet the monkey protests.
